title: xestrata
description: Configuration for the XeStrata SYCL inference server chart. In addition to the keys defined here, all values of the TrueCharts 'common' chart (service, ingress, hpa, podOptions, addons, ...) are accepted - see https://truecharts.org/common/

family.description: Model family: empty (original), coder, swift, unsloth, ornith, llmjp.

model.description: Quant size within the family (e.g. IQ2_XS, IQ3_S, Q2_0).

contextSize.description: Context length configured at setup time.

vision.description: Whether setup installs the image encoder: yes or no.

dataDir.description: Container path for the weight/cache mount; must match persistence.data.mountPath.

configDir.description: Container path for the setup config mount; must match persistence.config.mountPath.

apiKey.description: Optional API key, stored in a Secret when set.
